goals.description: Read the project’s critical Next.js performance guidance and inspect existing frontend components for local implementation patterns before changing code.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Focus only on gathering context. Read `docs/agent/architecture/nextjs-critical-fixes.md` and inspect relevant examples under `apps/frontend/components/`. Do not start broad edits yet; identify the patterns this codebase expects for data fetching, Suspense, imports, dynamic loading, Server Actions, and production deployment.
goals.name: Gather Next.js performance context

goals.description: Fix independent sequential awaits by running independent fetches concurrently and deferring awaits into the branches where their data is actually needed.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Focus on data-fetching concurrency. Find independent sequential awaits in the target code and replace them with `Promise.all()` or equivalent concurrent patterns. Where appropriate, defer `await` into the branch or component path that actually needs the data. Do not address bundle-size or Server Action issues in this goal unless directly required by the same data-fetching change.
goals.name: Remove data-fetching waterfalls

goals.description: Wrap slow or deferred data-loading UI in appropriate React Suspense boundaries so slow fetches do not block unrelated rendering.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Focus on Suspense boundaries. Identify slow data or deferred async UI and wrap it with suitable `<Suspense>` boundaries and fallbacks. Keep the scope to rendering behavior around slow fetches; avoid unrelated bundle or auth changes.
goals.name: Add Suspense for slow data

goals.description: Replace barrel icon imports, especially from packages such as `lucide-react`, with direct per-icon imports to reduce bundle size.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Focus on icon import bundle size. Find barrel imports such as `import X from 'lucide-react'` and convert them to direct icon imports such as `lucide-react/dist/esm/icons/x`, following project conventions. Do not refactor unrelated imports unless needed for this rule.
goals.name: Use direct icon imports

goals.description: Use `next/dynamic` for heavy components such as editors, charts, PDF viewers, and defer analytics or browser-only code with `ssr: false` where appropriate.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Focus on dynamic loading. Identify heavy or browser-only client components, including editors, charts, PDF viewers, and analytics, and move them behind `next/dynamic` as appropriate. Use `ssr: false` for analytics or client-only modules that should not run during SSR. Avoid changing unrelated data-fetching or auth logic.
goals.name: Dynamically load heavy client components

goals.description: Ensure Server Actions perform authentication inside the action itself and verify resource ownership before performing mutations.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Focus on Server Action safety. For each relevant Server Action, ensure authentication is checked inside the action, not only in middleware or callers. Before any mutation, verify the authenticated user owns or is authorized for the target resource. Keep this goal limited to Server Action authorization and mutation safety.
goals.name: Harden Server Actions

goals.description: Ensure production execution uses `npm run build && npm run start` rather than dev mode, and Docker configuration uses standalone output instead of development mode.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Focus on production build and deployment configuration. Check scripts, docs, Dockerfiles, and related config for use of `npm run build && npm run start` rather than `npm run dev` in production. Ensure Docker uses Next.js standalone output where applicable. Do not perform unrelated performance refactors in this goal.
goals.name: Check production build configuration

goals.description: Validate the completed changes against the skill’s PR checklist and production rules: no independent sequential awaits, direct icon imports, dynamic heavy components, Server Action auth, Suspense around slow fetches, and production build expectations.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Focus on final validation. Review the changed code against the checklist: no sequential awaits for independent data, icons imported directly, heavy components use `next/dynamic`, Server Actions authenticate internally, slow fetches have Suspense boundaries, and production build/Docker expectations are satisfied. If running commands is appropriate, prefer production-oriented validation such as `npm run build` rather than relying on dev mode.
goals.name: Run final performance checklist
